create_BitmapMasks: create BitmapMasks from a numpy array of shape (N, H, W) with height and width
create_PolygonMasks: create PolygonMasks from a nested list of polygon coordinate arrays with height and width
crop_and_resize_BitmapMasks: crop and resize BitmapMasks by bounding boxes using ROI align for mask target computation
convert_polygon_to_bitmap: convert polygon masks to bitmap representation using pycocotools mask utilities
convert_bitmap_to_polygon: convert bitmap masks to polygon representation using OpenCV findContours
